Use at the start of a conversation in a repo with docs/sessions (or to set one up), after each commit, and before finishing — "catch me up", "record that commit", "write the handoff". Not for authoring an ADR, a PRD or CONTEXT.md, for changing the session tool itself, or for a changelog of recent commits.
